#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, h;
    std::cin >> n >> h;

    std::vector<std::vector<long long>> dp(36, std::vector<long long>(36, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;

    for (int total_nodes = 1; total_nodes < 36; ++total_nodes) {
        for (int minheight = 0; minheight <= total_nodes; ++minheight) {
            for (int root = 1; root <= total_nodes; ++root) {
                int left_subtree = root - 1;
                int right_subtree = total_nodes - root;

                long long left_zero = dp[left_subtree][0];
                long long right_zero = dp[right_subtree][0];

                int max_minheight = std::max(minheight - 1, 0);

                long long left_diff = left_zero - (dp[left_subtree][0] - dp[left_subtree][max_minheight]);
                long long right_diff = right_zero - (dp[right_subtree][0] - dp[right_subtree][max_minheight]);

                dp[total_nodes][minheight] += left_zero * right_zero - left_diff * right_diff;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << static_cast<int>(dp[n][h]) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
